scenarios.title: A｜询问延误时间
scenarios.setting: 在“航班延误”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问延误时间”。

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Excuse me, how long is the flight delayed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, how long is the flight delayed?
feedback.explanation: “delayed”指延误的，不等于已经取消。

choices.text: Do you know how long the delay will be?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how long the delay will be?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Has a new departure time been announced?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has a new departure time been announced?
feedback.explanation: “departure time”指出发时间，区别于开始登机或检票的时间。

choices.text: Do you know when the flight is expected to leave?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know when the flight is expected to leave?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: How much time is the flight late?

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, how long is the flight delayed?
feedback.explanation: 航班延误时长常问“How long is the flight delayed?”；“late”通常描述晚于时间，而不这样搭配“how much time”。

turns.text: At the moment, we’re expecting a delay of about ninety minutes.

turns.prompt: 你想核实登机或起飞信息，会怎么问？

choices.text: So the new departure time is around 7:30?

feedback.naturalExpression: So the new departure time is around 7:30?
feedback.explanation: “departure time”指出发时间，区别于开始登机或检票的时间。

choices.text: Is that time confirmed, or could it change again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is that time confirmed, or could it change again?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Do you know what’s causing the delay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know what’s causing the delay?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: Should I stay near the gate?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I stay near the gate?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: The time is still estimated, so please keep checking the information screens.

turns.prompt: 你想了解后续航班变动会通过什么方式通知，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will there be another announcement if anything changes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will there be another announcement if anything changes?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Is there a way to get updates on my phone?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a way to get updates on my phone?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Okay, I’ll keep checking the screens.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll keep checking the screens.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜询问新登机时间
scenarios.setting: 在“航班延误”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问新登机时间”。

turns.prompt: 你想核实登机或起飞信息，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you know what time boarding will start now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know what time boarding will start now?
feedback.explanation: “boarding”指登机或上车过程，区别于航班、车次实际出发。

choices.text: Has a new boarding time been announced?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has a new boarding time been announced?
feedback.explanation: “boarding”指登机或上车过程，区别于航班、车次实际出发。

choices.text: When should I come back to the gate?

feedback.naturalExpression: When should I come back to the gate?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Is the original boarding time still valid?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the original boarding time still valid?
feedback.explanation: “boarding”指登机或上车过程，区别于航班、车次实际出发。

turns.text: We’re now expecting boarding to start at 6:45.

turns.prompt: 你想确认应该什么时候回到登机口等候，会怎么说？

choices.text: Should I be back here before 6:45?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I be back here before 6:45?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: What time would you recommend returning to the gate?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time would you recommend returning to the gate?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Will the boarding time be shown on the airport screens?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will the boarding time be shown on the airport screens?
feedback.explanation: “boarding”指登机或上车过程，区别于航班、车次实际出发。

choices.text: Could boarding start earlier than that?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could boarding start earlier than that?
feedback.explanation: “boarding”指登机或上车过程，区别于航班、车次实际出发。

turns.text: Please be back by 6:30 in case boarding starts early.

turns.prompt: 关于「航班延误」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: All right. I’ll be back by 6:30.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I’ll be back by 6:30.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll stay nearby.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll stay nearby.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜担心错过转机
scenarios.setting: 在“航班延误”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“担心错过转机”。

turns.prompt: 你担心行程衔接，想确认是否来得及，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m worried I’m going to miss my connecting flight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m worried I’m going to miss my connecting flight.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

choices.text: I have a connection in Frankfurt. Will I still have enough time?

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a connection in Frankfurt. Will I still have enough time?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: My next flight leaves at 9:10. Do you think I’ll make it?

feedback.naturalExpression: My next flight leaves at 9:10. Do you think I’ll make it?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: What happens if I miss my connection because of this delay?

feedback.naturalExpression: What happens if I miss my connection because of this delay?
feedback.explanation: 问清后续处理或结果，能在行动前了解可能的影响。

choices.text: I’m afraid I can’t catch my next airplane.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m worried I’m going to miss my connecting flight.
feedback.explanation: 转机时能否赶上下一班常说“make my connection”；“next airplane”没有突出衔接航班的关系。

turns.text: May I see your boarding pass for the connecting flight?

turns.prompt: 对方需要查看资料或物品，你会怎样配合？

choices.text: Sure. Here it is.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Here it is.
feedback.explanation: “here it is”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

choices.text: Of course. My connection is flight LH420.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. My connection is flight LH420.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes. I only have about an hour between flights now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I only have about an hour between flights now.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.text: It looks tight, but the connection is still possible if there are no further delays.

turns.prompt: 你想了解错过转机后该如何处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: What should I do if I miss it?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do if I miss it?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Will the airline rebook me automatically?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will the airline rebook me automatically?
feedback.explanation: “rebook”指重新预订或改订，重点是安排新的班次或时间。

choices.text: Is there another flight later tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there another flight later tonight?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Could you note that I have a tight connection?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you note that I have a tight connection?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: If you miss the connection because of this delay, please go to the transfer desk when you arrive.

turns.prompt: 你想了解后续航班如何安排，会怎么问？

choices.text: Will they help me get on the next available flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will they help me get on the next available flight?
feedback.explanation: “get on”在公共交通情景中表示上车，是说明乘车步骤的常用短语。

choices.text: Do I need to collect my checked bag first?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to collect my checked bag first?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Where is the transfer desk after I land?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where is the transfer desk after I land?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的信息限定为地点或位置，适合请人指路或定位物品。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll go straight there if I miss it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll go straight there if I miss it.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
